summary.business_type: Educational / Informational — Digital museum for ancient Chinese architectural heritage
summary.platform: Astro 5 static site with Tailwind CSS
top_findings: No sitemap.xml — 24 pages not submitted for search engine discovery
No canonical tags on any page
No structured data / JSON-LD schema anywhere on the site
No Open Graph or Twitter Card tags — no social sharing previews
quick_wins: Install @astrojs/sitemap integration for automatic sitemap generation
Add canonical tags to shared Layout.astro (single change, all pages benefit)
Add Organization + WebSite JSON-LD schema to Layout.astro
Add Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags to Layout.astro
Fix truncated meta descriptions by adding dedicated 150-160 char fields

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Clean, descriptive URL structure with consistent trailing slashes
Proper UTF-8 charset and viewport declarations
Rich internal linking between sections
Proper HTML lang attribute (lang=en)
Single minified CSS file per page from Astro build

findings.title: No robots.txt
findings.description: Search engines have zero crawl directives. Crawl budget may be wasted on irrelevant paths.
findings.recommendation: Create public/robots.txt pointing to sitemap and allowing all paths.

findings.title: No sitemap.xml
findings.description: 24 pages across 8 sections are not being proactively submitted to search engines for discovery.
findings.recommendation: Install @astrojs/sitemap integration for automatic sitemap generation.

findings.title: No canonical tags
findings.description: Every page is missing <link rel=canonical>. While no duplicate paths exist, canonicals protect against parameter-based duplicates.
findings.recommendation: Add canonical link to Layout.astro using Astro.url.pathname.

findings.title: No hreflang annotations
findings.description: The site is English-only but does not declare this with hreflang tags.

findings.title: Dead-end href=# links
findings.description: Multiple notable buildings in dynasty data link to # for non-existent pages.
findings.recommendation: Replace with external links or remove until pages exist.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Strong subject-matter expertise with accurate technical terminology
Long-form, substantive content on building and dynasty detail pages
Clear heading hierarchy (H1 > H2 > sidebar)
FAQ page uses semantic details/summary widgets
Scannable feature lists with visual checkmarks

findings.title: Truncated meta descriptions on 3 pages
findings.description: Forbidden City detail, Dougong, and Roofs pages have meta descriptions cut off mid-sentence because the full description field exceeds 160 characters.
findings.recommendation: Add a metaDescription field (150-160 chars) to Building and Element data interfaces.

findings.title: No author attribution
findings.description: No author bylines, bios, or credentials visible on any page, weakening E-E-A-T signals for an educational site.
findings.recommendation: Add author name and bio to About page, add meta name=author tag.

findings.title: No cited sources
findings.description: Content is presented without academic citations despite referencing specific historians like Liang Sicheng.
findings.recommendation: Add references section to building and dynasty pages.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Descriptive, keyword-rich title tags across all pages
Meta descriptions present on all pages (3 truncated)
Proper single H1 per page with clear topic focus
Internal linking uses descriptive anchor text

findings.title: No Open Graph tags
findings.description: Zero og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, or og:type tags. Shared links show no preview.
findings.recommendation: Add full OG tag set to Layout.astro with page-specific overrides.

findings.title: No Twitter Card tags
findings.description: No twitter:card, twitter:title, twitter:description, or twitter:image tags.
findings.recommendation: Add Twitter Card tags (summary_large_image) to Layout.astro.

findings.title: Title tag inconsistency
findings.description: Some pages use | Ancient Chinese Architecture suffix, homepage uses a longer format without suffix.
findings.recommendation: Standardize: Page Title | Ancient Chinese Architecture for all sub-pages.

findings.title: Zero structured data sitewide
findings.description: Not a single page contains JSON-LD, Microdata, or RDFa. This prevents rich results and limits SERP visibility.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization + WebSite schema to Layout.astro, BreadcrumbList to detail pages, FAQPage to /faq/.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Static HTML with minimal JavaScript (only IntersectionObserver)
Single minified CSS file per page
SVG favicon eliminates extra image request
Font loaded with font-display: swap

findings.title: Google Fonts from external CDN
findings.description: 2 DNS lookups + render-blocking CSS for Outfit font from Google CDN.
findings.recommendation: Self-host the Outfit font as woff2 files.

findings.title: Images from Unsplash CDN
findings.description: All building and element images loaded from images.unsplash.com with no local optimization.
findings.recommendation: Download and serve images locally using Astro Image component.

findings.title: No lazy loading on below-fold images
findings.description: Only the hero image uses loading=eager; no other images use loading=lazy.
findings.recommendation: Add loading=lazy decoding=async to all below-fold images.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Hero image has descriptive alt text
Unsplash URLs include width and quality parameters

findings.title: No og:image
findings.description: Zero social sharing previews. Links shared on social media show no image.
findings.recommendation: Create 1200x630 default OG image and page-specific OG images.

findings.title: Data model images lack alt text
findings.description: Building and Element TypeScript interfaces have images arrays but no alt text fields.
findings.recommendation: Add alt field to image data and populate for all entries.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Highly citable, factual content with specific dates, dimensions, and names
Semantic HTML structure with proper heading hierarchy
FAQ content in semantic details/summary widgets

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: No llms.txt or llms-full.txt at site root for LLM crawler guidance.
findings.recommendation: Create public/llms.txt listing all sections with descriptions.

findings.title: No author metadata for citation credit
findings.description: LLMs that cite content by referencing author names have no author to attribute to.
findings.recommendation: Add author meta tags and schema.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Add Open Graph + Twitter Card meta tags to Layout.astro
Fix truncated meta descriptions (add metaDescription field)

phases.name: Phase 2: Structured Data
items: Add Organization + WebSite JSON-LD to Layout.astro
Add BreadcrumbList schema to detail pages
Add TouristAttraction schema to building pages

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add source citations to building/dynasty content

phases.name: Phase 4: Performance & Images
items: Migrate images from Unsplash to local with Astro Image
Add resource preloading for hero image and fonts
Add explicit image dimensions and srcset
